meta.name: Maarnami
meta.description: Set against the vibrant coastal backdrop of Mangaluru and the traditional Hulivesha (tiger dance) art form, Maarnami follows the tumultuous life of Chethu, a young man caught between deep-rooted family heritage, love, and local conflicts. As personal tragedy and violent rivalries threaten to consume him, the sacred art of Hulivesha becomes his ultimate refuge and legacy, leading his story toward a haunting mystery
